text:
maya: hey folks — opening my first PR for the kv-cache logger. quick checklist before I open: branch/commit style, squash policy, who to ask for reviews?

maya: branch name I'm using: feat/maya/kv-cache-logger and commit: 'feat(runtime): add lightweight kv cache logger' — ok?

Samir: welcome :tada: that branch name follows our convention (feat|fix/<owner>/<short-desc>). Commit message: please use Conventional Commits and put more context in the body. e.g. `feat(runtime): add kv cache logger` and then explain why in the body.

Samir: merge policy: squash-on-merge for small PRs to keep main tidy. For larger architecture or multi-file refactors keep separate commits and request a rebase instead. If unsure, squash.

Linh: reviewers — add CODEOWNERS auto-requests or explicitly request @eng-runtime and one from @eng-platform for infra-touching changes. Runtime core changes need 2 approvals including one runtime owner. Docs/README changes: 1 approver is fine.

Linh: run local tests before opening: `./dev/run_local.sh --unit` and `pytest tests/runtime` to catch flakes early.

Ashley: pre-commit hooks run in CI (black/ruff/isort + our custom linter). Run locally: `pre-commit run --all-files`. PR template in repo root has a checklist: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/blob/main/.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md

Palmer: check CI matrix badge on PR. If CI fails on any runner, expand logs. Common fails: mypy, lint, integration timeout.

maya: question — rebase vs merge main into branch before opening?

Samir: rebase on main to keep history linear: `git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main && git push --force-with-lease`.

Palmer: handy snippet for new devs:

```
# create branch
git checkout -b feat/<you>/short-desc
# work...
git add -A
git commit -m "feat(runtime): short description

More details explaining why."
# keep branch up to date
git fetch origin
git rebase origin/main
# open PR
gh pr create --base main --fill
```

Samir: CODEOWNERS note — changes under `runtime/` auto-request @eng-runtime-owner. For urgent reviews add label `pr:fast-track` and ping Samir.

linter-bot: pre-commit failed on `src/runtime/logger.py: line 42` — please run `pre-commit run --files src/runtime/logger.py` locally.

maya: ack, fixing. Do we squash the lint fix commits before merge?

Linh: leave small fix commits for reviewer clarity — squash-on-merge will collapse them on main. Keep commit messages clear.

Ashley: add changelog entry if user-facing behavior changes (see `docs/CHANGELOG.md`) otherwise mention in PR body.

maya: great, thanks — will open the PR in ~30m and ping reviewers. :rocket:
